HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in early 2027!

Ride. Trick. Win. HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate is a white-knuckle love letter to the extreme sports games that defined the Y2K era, and it's coming to Nintendo Switch 2!

Choose your racer from a colorful cast of boarders and carve through courses based on real-world locations. Race, catch death-defying air, string together combos, or just poke around and find what's hidden in each trick-packed locale in Chill Mode.

Unlock new boards and cosmetics to show off your style, then prove it where it counts: split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer.

#HYPERyuki

Everything is Crab – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Everything is Crab evolves onto Nintendo Switch on November 24, 2026, with a free upgrade for Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch on January 26, 2027.

Darwin, a small blue blob with infinite potential, must survive a living ecosystem by any means necessary. Fight, befriend, and evade other creatures, from docile Blobfish and aggressive Beewares to massive boss monsters like the Crabtaur and Shellephant.

Find food to level up and choose from over 125+ evolutions and specializations to create your ultimate life form! Will you be a predator at the top of the food chain, or a scrappy survivor who believes in love, not war?

Earn genetic mutations to give you new advantages at the start of a run and take on hardcore Challenges designed to crack even the toughest shells. Survive and adapt... or get Darwin’d trying!

A free Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade will add Joy-Con 2 mouse controls and enhanced performance in January 2027.

#EverythingisCrab

Discover Lost and Found Co. when it arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch in 2027!

Every lost item has a story.

Lost and Found Co. is a hidden-object adventure in a cozy, immersive world. Join Ducky, a duck-turned-human intern, at Goddess Mei’s company on their epic journey across countless magical locations filled with hundreds of hand-drawn objects and secrets to interact with.

Uncover lost belongings, meet charming characters, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It! – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It! lands on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch in spring 2027!

Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It! is a slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms to the max. Hop in an elevator and search for lost relics in an impossible office tower, a vertical sandbox of secrets filled with absurd escape room-style puzzles that will keep you thinking and laughing at the same time. Everything within reach of your stretchy arms is satisfyingly interactive and responsive to your touch, so explore and slap everything. You never know what might happen!
